about: Fourteen things an owner might tell the Desk, written for the recall evaluation. Each question set (dev.jsonl, test.jsonl) names the notes a question is about. Written by the people who built the recall, as the other question sets are.

notes.content: Work on the billing module counts as landed once it is merged and the checks are green.
Never count commits by dependabot as human work.
The interns team shares one seat, so attribute their sessions to the team lead.
Opus is only for architecture reviews; everything else should run on Sonnet or Haiku.
Our month closes on the 25th, not on the last day.
Contractors from Northwind work Tuesday to Thursday only.
The data-platform repo is exempt from the daily cap during incident weeks.
Refactor sessions are cheap to retry, so do not treat a retry as waste.
Anything tagged experiment may be abandoned without counting as a failure.
Dana approves any spend above two hundred dollars a day.
Treat sessions that end with a revert as not landed.
Invoices from the vendor arrive by email on the first Monday of the month.
The mobile team prefers Haiku for lint fixes and test generation.
Sessions started by the nightly job should never be charged to a person.
